captions.detailed: This is a portable camping air pump featuring a blue main cylinder with a black base and top cap. A metallic silver rod extends upward from the cylinder to a black T-shaped handle. Two flat, rectangular black stabilizer feet fold out horizontally from the sides of the base via small silver hinge pins. The T-handle and rod translate vertically along the central axis of the cylinder, while the stabilizer feet can rotate on their hinges to fold flat against the sides.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a portable camping pump with a blue cylinder, a black base, a metallic silver piston rod, and a black T-handle. Incorporate two fold-out flat stabilizer feet on the sides of the base, connected by rotating hinges, and define a prismatic joint for the vertical handle-and-rod pump action.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a 'base' link consisting of a blue cylinder (using Cylinder) capped with a black top ring and a rectangular black base plate (using Box). A 'handle' link is modeled using a long, thin cylinder for the metallic rod and a perpendicular horizontal cylinder for the T-handle grip, connected to the base with a prismatic joint. Two 'foot' links are modeled as flat rectangular boxes, each attached to the left and right sides of the base with revolute joints representing the folding hinges.
